'''January 2001 Minneapolis tournament (23 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 23 January 2001. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1665">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-24-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1665/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 24 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-24-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1665/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
